queue.title: Reward and credit assignment ablation
queue.finding: Naive terminal trajectory credit was the only credit scheme that remained directionally promising, but its powered n=96 edge-error gain remained unresolved (delta -0.105, CI [-0.279,+0.064]); do not replace unweighted width-2 yet.

queue.title: Hidden-confounder transfer
queue.hypothesis: The supported breadth controller remains useful when observational dependencies include one latent common cause absent from the 29,281-DAG hypothesis space.
queue.design: Generate linear five-node observed DAGs plus one latent Gaussian parent of two observed nodes. Inference remains the observed-variable linear-Gaussian DAG posterior. Compare corrected nested width1 vs uniform width2 under equal intervention budget; perfect interventions remove latent and observed incoming causes of the target. Screen n=12 then power if promising.
queue.primary_metric: paired edge error over the observed ground-truth DAG
secondary_metrics: true-DAG mass interpreted cautiously under latent misspecification

queue.title: Imperfect-intervention transfer
queue.hypothesis: Proposal breadth remains useful when interventions are soft or noisy rather than perfect do-operations.

queue.title: Nonstationary transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller with explicit model-uncertainty handling degrades less when mechanisms drift during the experiment trajectory.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Initial-state and local-margin depth gates failed to justify deeper search.
Uniform width-2 proposal breadth improves edge recovery over width-1 across combined n=72 matched correctly specified worlds, with bootstrap CI excluding zero, at roughly 2x compute.
The width-2 gain is a portfolio effect rather than one globally best extra role.
Simple adaptive breadth thresholds failed strict preregistered validation; uniform width-2 remains the supported correctly specified benchmark controller.
Under nonlinear ground truth, forcing linear-Gaussian inference sharply degrades absolute recovery and does not preserve the width-2 breadth advantage.
Nonlinear-aware local likelihoods substantially repair absolute recovery under nonlinear ground truth, but the width-2 advantage remains unresolved at n=96 after corrected nested-breadth controls.
A simple linear-vs-nonlinear posterior-disagreement bonus changes many intervention choices but worsens edge recovery prospectively; model disagreement is not itself a useful proposal reward.

Among tested role-credit schemes, naive terminal trajectory credit is the only directionally promising one, but it remains unresolved at n=96 and does not yet justify replacing the unweighted width-2 controller.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
